documents.title: Information memorandum
documents.text:
Information memorandum — Sorrel Industries (fictional).
In this document "SIH" means Sorrel Industries. Sorrel AB reports gross margin of 47.3% for FY2024. Sorrel Industries reports approximately EBITDA of $43m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Sorrel Industries reports revenue of $620.3m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Sorrel Industries reports headcount of 2071 for FY2025 on a reported basis. For Sorrel Industries, the leakage definition is read as: permitted leakage excludes management bonuses.
